Hi Sara / Amit —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call:
- Primary use case: realtime customer support summarization + routing (inference on incoming queries).
- Expected traffic profile: steady baseline with periodic spikes during product launches.
- Security: SOC2 + regional data residency are important; will follow up on Private deployment options if needed.

Next steps we agreed on: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to align on throughput, latency SLOs, model choices, and rollout plan. To make the sizing call productive, please confirm or provide the following ahead of the meeting if possible:
1) Expected peak QPS / sustained QPS (or average qps ranges).
2) Target latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for the main endpoints.
3) Typical prompt + response token lengths (avg/max).
4) Concurrency expectations and burst patterns (daily/weekly).
5) Preferred model family (open-source or managed) and any quantization constraints.
6) Any compliance constraints or data-retention requirements to factor into architecture.

Suggested time windows (PT):
- Thu Mar 4, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Fri Mar 5, 08:00–09:00 PT
Or share a slot that works: https://calendly.com/redwood/dedicated-sizing

Attaching the high-level mutual action plan we discussed.

Thanks — happy to coordinate calendar invites once you confirm a slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. Thu Mar 4 at 10:30 PT would work for us (we can do 10:00–11:00, 10:30 is fine). Please include our infra lead Amit and I’ll bring baseline metrics.

Quick answers to your prep questions:
- Expected peak QPS: ~250 qps (peak day spikes up to ~600 qps for short windows).
- Sustained baseline QPS: ~80–120 qps.
- Latency targets: p50 < 250–300ms; p95 target < 800ms (prefer lower if possible).
- Token sizes: avg prompt ~120 tokens, avg response ~180 tokens; max combined ~2048 tokens for a small subset of use cases.
- Preferred models: leaning towards an open model in the 7B–13B class initially; interested in Redwood-verified profiles.
- Compliance: need to discuss data retention and whether logs can be routed to our VPC for audit.

Attaching our recent API metrics export for reference.

Thanks — look forward to the deep dive.
